capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: 204 kWh usable (reported) for the 24-module pack; 24 modules per the GM spec guide, so 204 x 24/24 = 204. Third-party tables also list 119 / 170 / 205. Years on this powertrain: 2024. Pack mapping for the 2024 trim: The Weekly Driver 24-module page lists "2024: RST First Edition and WT 4WT" on this pack. Also matches the NRCan range. The Weekly Driver 24-module page gives 205 kWh "as published" (usable or total not stated).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Maximum Range (24 MOD) pack. Charges at 800 V.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Maximum Range (24 MOD) pack. 800 V up to 350 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Maximum Range (24 MOD) pack. 19.2 kW module on Maximum Range.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: GM 2025 WT spec guide lists the Maximum Range (24 MOD) pack. Low-80% time to charge 46 min and 124 miles added in 10 min; column mapping to this pack inferred from the page layout (4WT 74 mi, 5WT 111 mi, 8WT 124 mi).
